title: ThinkSuit Turn Result
description: The surface contract for what a caller receives from a single turn.

success.description: Whether the turn produced a usable response

response.description: The assistant response text (or a status message on failure/interrupt)

cwd.description: The working directory the turn ran in (echoed back to the caller)

error.description: Error description when the turn did not succeed

interrupted.description: True when the turn was interrupted by the user

partialData.description: Any partial result captured at interrupt time
